name: state_format_handles_thoughtseize_re_reveal_fresh
why: docs/state_format.md §6 / CR 701.20a: the caster's handles for the cards Thoughtseize reveals exist only while the reveal lasts; the discarded card is linked into the graveyard, the rest retire as the window closes, and a second Thoughtseize issues fresh handles, never the retired ones (step 1 T2 handles, --trace-handles)
expect_order: ^HANDLE: issue A h\d+ hand:B Force of Will$
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:B Lightning Bolt \(zone change\)$
^HANDLE: link A h\d+ -> h\d+ graveyard:B Lightning Bolt$
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:B Force of Will \(window closed\)$
^HANDLE: issue A h\d+ hand:B Force of Will$
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:B Grizzly Bears \(zone change\)$
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:B Force of Will \(window closed\)$
